html:
Soroca Fortress is a round stone fort on the Dniester River in northern Moldova, rebuilt in stone in the 1540s on a wooden fort raised under Stephen the Great in 1499.

It was one of a chain of forts that guarded the eastern border of Moldavia along the Dniester against Tatar raids from the steppe. Its five bastions form a near perfect circle. In 1711 Peter the Great crossed nearby during his failed Pruth campaign against the Ottomans. Today it is one of the best preserved medieval monuments in Moldova, and Soroca is also known as the unofficial capital of the country's Roma.
sum: Soroca Fortress is a round stone fort on the Dniester River in northern Moldova, rebuilt in stone in the 1540s on a wooden fort raised under Stephen the Great in 1499.
